exposure: weight gain (WG) less than 120 g during postnatal day 10-19
WG less than 180 g during day 20-29
WG less than 170 g during day 30-39
occurrence of grade 3 or 4 intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 684 infants (53.4% boys) who received ROP screening with a median birth weight of 1200g and median gestational age of 30 weeks.
finding: The G-ROP criteria, both original and modified (including IVH grade 3 or 4), demonstrated 100% sensitivity for identifying type 1, 2, or treatment-requiring ROP cases, suggesting their applicability in this hospital setting.
